analogue: Gas-phase OH oxidation and ring opening of toluene and 1,2,4-trimethylbenzene to glyoxal, methylglyoxal and other oxygenated fragments.
citation: Mechanistic study of the formation of ring-retaining and ring-opening products from the oxidation of aromatic compounds under urban atmospheric conditions
evidence: Product measurements in aromatic photooxidation identified first-generation ring-opening dicarbonyls from these aromatic precursors.
difference: The measured parent aromatics differ from o-cresol, whose oxidation also has strong ring-retaining channels. No o-cresol-specific cleavage yield, delayed reservoir lifetime or conversion of all reactant mass to one oxygenated vapor follows.
